name: Imperva Cache Purger
description: Integration IMPERVA cache with module purge.
project_description: Imperva Cache Purger is a Purge-module purger plugin that propagates Drupal cache invalidations to the Imperva (formerly Incapsula) CDN/WAF edge via Imperva's Cloud Application Security REST API. Imperva is deployed as a reverse proxy in front of the whole Drupal site; when content changes the edge must be told to drop its cached copies or visitors keep seeing stale pages. The module registers a single Purge purger (plugin id imperva_cache_purger) supporting path, wildcard-path, everything and tag invalidations, and issues DELETE requests to https://my.imperva.com/api/prov/v2/sites/{site_id}/cache authenticated with an Imperva API id/key. A kernel response subscriber also stamps a Cache-Tag header on cacheable responses so Imperva can associate edge objects with Drupal cache tags. Configuration (API id, API key, site id, invalidation type, optional endpoint override, enable/disable) lives on the purger's own config form reached from Purge's admin UI at /admin/config/development/performance/purge. Requires the Purge module; no submodules, permissions, or Drush commands of its own.
